newsitem.title: USA: Westpoint Stevens sets 3.0 mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Westpoint Stevens sets 3.0 mln share buyback.

text.p: WestPoint Stevens Inc said Thursday its board has approved the repurchase of up to 3.0 million shares of the company's common stock.

The shares repurchased will be used for acquired for general corporate purposes, including awards under the company's stock-based incentive compensation plans and stock matching under its employee 401(k) retirement savings value plan, it said.
The stock repurchase is subject to certain applicable limitations in its debt facilities, it said.
Westpoint, a maker of home fashions consumer products, had 30.4 million common shares outstanding as of July 31, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
